title: The Playlist of the quarry
author: Noor Blackwood
blurb: Coral Vasquez, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
